title: 2026 LPC Alerts Update
subtitle: Important information about LPC Alerts
keyMessage: LPC Alerts has moved to a new platform. Please re-register to continue receiving emergency notifications.

why.title: Why am I seeing this?
paragraphs: La Plata County has transitioned to a new emergency alerting platform. All residents need to re-register to continue receiving LPC Alerts about wildfires, floods, evacuations, and other emergencies.

noAccount.title: I'm not sure if I have an account
paragraphs: If you previously received LPC Alerts, you will need to sign up again on the new platform to continue receiving notifications.
Signing up ensures you receive critical alerts by phone, text, and email during emergencies in La Plata County.
